delivery.strategy: Small bounded static public assets, fetched on demand. No runtime provider request, credentials or external account. Preserve original bytes in source package; raster decode may be capped by rendering quality without implying added data.
delivery.lazyLoad: Load selected or approached destination first; discard superseded requests and decoded resources on scene teardown. Original full-resolution Jupiter and Saturn images each need 64MiB RGBA8 including mipmaps; efficient1024 cap needs4MiB each, balanced2048 cap16MiB each.
delivery.scientificLimits: These files supply appearance, never positions, ephemerides, radii, time, observer visibility, calibrated terrain or qualified body orientation.

existingQualifiedAssets.moon: Existing read-only LROC morphology pack remains unchanged; 2880x1440, 8px/degree, no measured elevation.
